collection.description: An elder recalls a race that ended in a spectacular tumble years ago.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: (Name1), an elder, recalls a race that ended in a spectacular tumble years ago. Afterward, the competitors share water and compare stories.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: (Name1), an elder, recalls a race that ended in a spectacular tumble years ago. (Name1) feels nervous despite insisting it is only for fun.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: (Name1), an elder, recalls a race that ended in a spectacular tumble years ago. The spectators cheer for everyone approaching the finish.

e4.text: (Name1), an elder, recalls a race that ended in a spectacular tumble years ago. Someone starts too early and sheepishly returns to the line.
